messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up - customer 'Cedar Biotech' says promo code APRILFREE (first $500 free) didn't apply to their April invoice (INV-2026-0520). They were charged $620. They want a credit or refund. @Owen can you check?

Owen Walker: Looking now. Invoice INV-2026-0520 shows usage 620, no promo applied. Subscription sub_cdr_0912 has promo on file but promo start date is 2026-04-10 and their billing period is 2026-04-01 to 04-30 -> edge case. Promo should have been backdated for prorated period per promo rules.

Priya Nair: Customer says they signed up 2026-04-03 and were promised the promo for April. We should honor and do manual adjustment. Options: $500 credit note or refund $500. Customer prefers credit note applied to next invoice.

Owen Walker: Proposed action: issue credit note CN-1821 for $500, apply to next invoice, mark as promo_proration_CEDAR_0426, GL code 6543. Needs approval from Leah for accounting.

Leah Kim: Approved. Use code 6543 and tag month=Apr2026_promos. Also add a one-line memo for their finance team explaining prorated promo effective 2026-04-03.

Owen Walker: Creating CN-1821 now. Command: 
```
/create-credit --customer sub_cdr_0912 --amount 500 --reason "prorated promo APRILFREE - backdated to 2026-04-03" --acct_code 6543 --apply_next_invoice true
```

billing-bot: Credit created CN-1821, amount $500, status=applied_to_next_invoice. Ledger note: "prorated promo APRILFREE honored per CS request; memo sent to customer". Posted to accounting queue GL 1200/6543.

Owen Walker: Sent CN-1821 and note to billing contact accounting@cedarbiotech.com and CC'd Priya. Customer replied "thank you, that's perfect".

CS-bot: Logged customer message; asked if they want a pdf memo for AP  they said yes. Priya, can you send the short memo?

Priya Nair: Sent memo: "We applied a $500 prorated promotional credit (APRILFREE) to be applied against your next invoice per signup date 2026-04-03." Customer confirmed receipt.

Owen Walker: Closing thread. Audit tag: promo_proration_CEDAR_0426. Leaving note in billing adjustments for April.

Leah Kim: Thanks team. Keep an eye on promo effective dates in onboarding flow to avoid future backdating.
thread_summary: Cedar Biotech billed full for April due to promo start-date edge case; finance issued a $500 credit note CN-1821 to apply to next invoice as a prorated promo adjustment.
